summary: Requires the Secretary of Energy to submit annual reports to Congress detailing water use from public systems and electricity consumption, self-generation, and connection costs for data centers covered by Executive Order 14318.

scores.thoughts: The bill requires the Department of Energy (in consultation with EPA) to produce periodic reports on data center resource use. This imposes a minor administrative obligation on federal agencies but does not authorize new programs, appropriations, subsidies, or spending reductions. The findings mention avoiding federal subsidies, yet the operative text contains no spending provisions. Therefore the bill has no meaningful bearing on government spending levels.

While this creates transparency around environmental externalities, it neither expands regulatory protections nor limits environmental rules; it is strictly an information-gathering measure.
